timeline_reviews.summary: Reviewed serial transport stream; semantic parent actions are represented in the raw agent trajectory.
Reviewed serial parent trajectory: it implemented the package locally, ran official reference suites, and added local tests without delegation.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the python-fsutil package API, packaging, examples, and evaluator-aligned pytest requirements from the prompt and upstream references.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership, created task tracker items, wrote all package modules and tests, then launched a read-only adversarial audit workflow after passing suites.
parallel.implementation: Implemented src/fsutil modules, pyproject and support files, conftest, local tests, and compatibility behavior for upstream 0.15, 0.16, and 0.17 suites.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled the package in /workspace and artifact validation captured the source tree; children were instructed to inspect only and not modify /workspace.
parallel.verification: The parent ran import smoke checks and all three upstream reference test suites before workflow delegation; official evaluation later passed 155/153.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow audit did not complete and one child found a possible hidden Path/symlink defect, but this advisory result was not integrated and did not affect official pass status.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same python-fsutil API and packaging task from the identical prompt, using upstream package/test references as ground truth.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial parent performed all exploration, implementation, packaging, verification, and local test creation itself with delegation tools disabled.
serial.implementation: Implemented the fsutil package, packaging metadata, source modules, tests, and conftest locally without child ownership or workflow handoff.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated the package directly in /workspace and delivered the artifact tree without subagent writes or cross-agent reconciliation.
serial.verification: Ran official upstream v0.17, v0.15, and v0.16 compatibility suites and local tests; official evaluation later passed 155/153.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No serial delegation remained unresolved; any non-evaluator hidden behavior concerns were not surfaced by an audit workflow and official evaluation passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full python-fsutil package reconstruction and multi-version upstream compatibility requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and upstream package/test-suite requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference is shown; both aimed at the same API and official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent owned implementation and later spawned a workflow for adversarial audit children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial parent owned all work, with Workflow and delegation tools disabled in the run command and validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The difference is advisory delegation after implementation in parallel versus fully local serial execution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gave children audit context stating the implementation was under /workspace and official suites already passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child briefs or handoff interfaces because the parent kept all context locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only the parallel run had child context boundaries, but they were read-only audit boundaries rather than implementation contracts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote the package modules directly in the parent trajectory before starting workflow audit.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also wrote the package modules directly in the single parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both produced a working fsutil implementation; the implementation path differed mainly by parallel adding a later audit workflow.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow state ended without an aggregate result, while individual child logs and journal entries remained available.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; results were parent tool outputs and local files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an incomplete advisory workflow lifecycle, but no delegated implementation result needed to be joined.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent integrated the package itself and workflow children were instructed not to modify /workspace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and integrated all files locally with no shared child workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No harmful shared-state collision is evidenced; the parallel shared workspace was used by the parent for delivery and children for read-only audit.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel passed upstream v0.17 and v0.15/v0.16 suites before audit, then passed official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial passed upstream v0.17 and v0.15/v0.16 suites, added local tests, then passed official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had strong official-suite verification and both official evaluations passed; serial also recorded local 83-test pass before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after launching audit workflow, but artifact validation and official evaluation still succeeded.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out near the cell budget after completing deliverables, with no subagents and official evaluation success.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both consumed the run budget; only parallel spent budget on advisory audit fan-out, without changing the pass outcome.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both current completed cell/status.json evaluations report solution_passed true with 155 passed and 153 total. The process difference is that parallel added a post-implementation adversarial audit workflow, whereas serial solved locally without delegation. The audit did not become a required implementation dependency and did not alter the official result.
parallel_contributors: Parent implementation and official-suite verification were completed before workflow audit delegation.
Audit workflow produced child activity but no aggregate result was integrated into the delivered package.
serial_contributors: Single parent trajectory implemented and verified the package without delegation boundaries.
Serial control validation confirms no workflow, child logs, or parallel execution occurred.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel child audit surfaced a possible hidden Path/symlink issue, but this was advisory and not an official outcome difference.
Parallel and serial package metadata/details differed in places, yet both satisfied the official evaluator.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process contrast only, with no retained adverse parallel coordination pattern
